facts.summary: FDA partial clinical hold after fatal bleeding events · Phase 3 and Phase 1 · UpRi in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a partial clinical hold pausing new patient enrollment in UP-NEXT and UPGRADE-A, the company’s ongoing clinical trials of UpRi in platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer.
evidence.safety: five (<1%) Grade 5 (fatal) bleeding events were observed among the approximately 560 patients dosed to date.
evidence.program_discontinued: The company plans to seek alignment with the FDA to lift the partial clinical hold and resume enrollment in UP-NEXT and UPGRADE-A.
